name: supplyguard
description: SupplyGuard — SBOM generation, license review and supply-chain vulnerability scanning. Root scripts proxy to frontend/ and backend/.

scripts.dev:api: bash scripts/ensure-db.sh && npm --prefix backend run dev:api
scripts.start:api: bash scripts/ensure-db.sh && npm --prefix backend run start:api
scripts.dev:worker: bash scripts/ensure-db.sh && npm --prefix backend run dev:worker
scripts.start:worker: bash scripts/ensure-db.sh && npm --prefix backend run start:worker
